name: Baby Registry Welcome Box
whatYouGet: Gift box of sample and full-size items for parent and baby; Amazon does not list the contents. It is not free without Prime and registry purchases.
costDetail: Requires an active Prime account, a registry with 10 unique items, and over $10 of purchases from the registry (by you or others).
eligibility: Primary registry owner with an active Prime account; Amazon Business accounts do not qualify.
catches: Amazon's help page (read via domain search snippet; the page itself did not fetch cleanly) says tax, shipping, Prime and gift card purchases don't count toward the $10, the box shows $35 until a $35 promotional balance is applied, it ships to the contiguous US only, and a new box needs an 8-month wait. Limited-time and subject to change. Needs a paid Prime membership and a purchase from the registry, so nothing arrives with no purchase. Contents are a surprise and past reviews vary from useful samples to mostly coupons.
notes: The same registry page also advertises a 15% completion discount, up to $300 in savings, and free 1-year returns. Older Q&A mentions a 60% checklist rule; the current page says 10 items.
valueBasis: Box shown at $35 before the promo balance; contents are a surprise, so low end taken

name: Baby Registry Welcome Box
whatYouGet: Baby Box with at least six sample-size baby or parenting products plus discount coupons; contents vary.
costDetail: Free box. Registry created on or after 2/1/25, open 7+ days, 20+ unique items, and over $25 purchased through your registry link (items marked Purchased don't count).
eligibility: Adults 18+ in the 50 US states and Puerto Rico; one box per person, Walmart account and household per 365 days.
catches: While supplies last, first come first served; not guaranteed even after meeting requirements and Walmart need not notify you if supplies run out; contents may be substituted; allow 10-12 weeks by US mail to the registry address (no P.O. boxes). The box is free, but only after over $25 is purchased through the registry.
notes: Claim via the banner on your registry page; you get a confirmation email. Support: support@walmartbabywelcomebox.com. The page shows no separate free postpartum or mom box.
valueBasis: At least six sample-size items plus coupons; low end of what such samples cost
whenNote: Registry must be open 7+ days; box takes 10-12 weeks to arrive by mail

name: Free cleaning service with baby registry
whatYouGet: One free home cleaning (1 bedroom, 1 bathroom, kitchen and common areas in a single home, a $99 value) from a partner service provider.
costDetail: Registry open 7+ days with 20+ unique items and $300 spent on items from the registry (by you or invited gifters).
eligibility: Adults 18+ in the 48 contiguous states; limit one per person. Registry must be created on or after the reward start date (Feb 9, 2026).
catches: Available while supplies last; fulfilled by an unaffiliated service provider with its own terms; must redeem no later than 90 days after your registry event date; merchandise total excludes taxes, shipping and fees, and items marked purchased don't count.
notes: Walmart calls this a Tier 2 registry reward alongside the Baby Box.
valueBasis: Walmart states a $99 value; needs $300 of registry purchases first
whenNote: Redeem no later than 90 days after your registry event date

name: Hello Baby Box
whatYouGet: Free welcome box of product samples and partner offers (diapers/wipes, bottles, skincare, coupons); contents vary.
costDetail: Add 3 items from other stores, complete 40% of the registry checklist, make a $30+ Babylist Shop purchase (a gifter may), and pay $8.95 plus tax shipping.
eligibility: Arrival date under 9 months away or baby under 4 weeks old; one box per household and per registry; US addresses.
catches: Shipping fee is non-refundable and orders can't be changed; AK/HI total shipping $18.95; gift cards and return credit can't pay the fee; Babylist Health and other retailer orders don't count toward the $30.
notes: Babylist's help center blocks automated reading, so these terms come from official-domain search results and may be incomplete. Babylist's marketing FAQ says one box per household per year; the help center says per household and per registry. The sign-up link opens Babylist's "Create a Baby Registry" page because a registry is needed first; the help center says to claim the box from the For You tile on your registry dashboard or in the app. The older /hello-baby/box address only redirects to the help center.
valueBasis: Sample-size items and partner offers that vary; low end taken, minus the $8.95 shipping fee
whenNote: Arrival date must be under 9 months away, or baby under 4 weeks old

name: MacroBaby Gift Box
whatYouGet: Free welcome box of baby samples, coupons and products from trusted brands, est. value $80+; contents are random and seasonal. Added to your shipment after your first qualifying registry purchase.
costDetail: Add at least 20 items to a registry and make a first qualifying purchase of $15 or more from it.
catches: Contents can't be requested; if the qualifying items are returned the box must be returned or an $80 fee applies; program can change or end without notice.
notes: Gift box page confirmed directly: add at least 20 items to your registry and make a first qualifying purchase of $15.00 or more from it. The Baby Registry page also advertises 5% cash back on registry purchases.
valueBasis: MacroBaby gives an est. value of $80+; contents are random and seasonal

name: Registry welcome bag
whatYouGet: Goody bag with free samples, coupons and a Registry Guide.
costDetail: Free with registry; no purchase stated in the search results; available for pickup in stores only.
eligibility: Baby registrants; details of eligibility not confirmed.
catches: Pickup in stores only; ask for the bag when registering in person per store pages. Eligibility and any purchase conditions were not stated in the results.
notes: Checked from the official site's search results; the site blocks automated reading, so details may be incomplete. buybuy BABY pages refused or failed to fetch; store-page search snippets still describe a free goody bag with samples, coupons and a registry guide. Snippets also mention a 15% completion discount and free first-year shipping after $1,500 of registry gifts.
freeStuff: A bag of free samples, coupons and a Registry Guide, picked up in a store when you register.
valueBasis: A few samples and a guide; the contents are not listed

name: Registry Welcome Kit (Target Baby Box)
whatYouGet: Welcome kit valued at $100, a mix of samples and a Target Circle Bonus.
costDetail: Kit is free of charge but shipping and handling fees apply. Needs a free Target Circle account, a baby registry with 10 unique items, and a purchase over $10 from the registry (by you or others).
eligibility: Active baby registries created after 08/15/2023 that haven't claimed a previous kit; one kit per year.
catches: Online only, as a Target Circle Bonus that must be accepted; shipping and handling fees apply; limit one kit per year; registries that claimed a previous kit aren't eligible. Allow 24-48 hours for the bonus to be issued.
notes: Active registries created after 08/15/2023 are eligible. The bonus shows on the registry dashboard. Target's registry sign-up page and product page did not mention the kit in readable text, so only the help article confirms it.
valueBasis: Target labels it a $100 value, but that mixes samples with a Circle Bonus; samples at low end, bonus counted as a saving

name: Registry Completion Discount (15%)
whatYouGet: 15% off remaining eligible registry items, saving up to $300.
costDetail: Free to use. Baby registry active at least 14 days; primary registrant only.
valueBasis: Amazon caps the saving at $300; 15% of about $400 to $2,000 left on the registry
whenNote: Window opens 60 days before your arrival date and ends 90 days after
catches: Cannot be combined with Lightning Deals or Prime Day deals; returned items do not restore the discount; terms can change.
notes: Seen only as Amazon help-page search results. The registry benefits page also mentions free gift returns for a year.

name: Registry Completion Discount (15%)
whatYouGet: 15% off storewide Target Circle offer for items left on your baby registry, usable twice.
costDetail: Free. Registry must be active at least 14 days.
eligibility: Registry owner with a free Target Circle account.
valueBasis: 15% of about $300 to $1,500 bought after the offer arrives
whenNote: Offer is generated eight weeks before the expected arrival date
catches: Redeemable twice (one in-store, one online per one help page); expires in 6 months; once per 12 months; cannot be combined with price match.
notes: Search results from different Target pages differ slightly on the use limits.

name: Registry Completion Discount (15%)
whatYouGet: 15% off eligible items in the Babylist Shop, up to $600 saved on $4,000 of purchases.
costDetail: Free to use. Registry must be at least 30 days old.
eligibility: Registry owner and partner; collaborators cannot use it.
valueBasis: 15% of about $300 to $1,500 bought in the Babylist Shop
whenNote: Activates 60 days before the due date; the FAQ says 90 days after (an older page says 6 months)
catches: Applies only to Babylist Shop items, not other stores added to the registry.
notes: Window length differs between Babylist pages; the shorter, newer one is used.

name: Registry Completion Discount (15%)
whatYouGet: 15% off remaining registry items and items you add, online, in store or by phone.
costDetail: Free to use; click Redeem in your registry before each online purchase.
valueBasis: 15% of about $130 to $650 of non-excluded items; baby gear is excluded
whenNote: Eligible 60 days before the event date and for up to 180 days after
catches: Excludes all baby gear, MSRP items and select clearance items.
notes: Older pages show shorter windows; the current page says 60 days before to 180 days after.

name: Registry Completion Discount (15%)
whatYouGet: Two 15% discount codes by email: one single-use before the due date, one multi-use after.
costDetail: Free; used in US stores, on crateandkids.com or by phone.
valueBasis: 15% of about $130 to $650 bought for the nursery; excludes books and gift cards
whenNote: First code valid 3 months before the event date, second for 6 months after
catches: Not for kids books, gift cards or certain brands; cannot be combined with other offers except free shipping; terms can change. Some pages say 10%.
notes: The terms page says 15%; other pages differ.

name: Baby Registry Completion Discount (10%)
whatYouGet: 10% off select remaining registry items and select new additions, online or in store.
valueBasis: 10% of about $100 to $500 of eligible brands; baby gear is excluded
whenNote: Starts 60 days before the arrival date and runs 180 days after
catches: Select brands only; cannot be combined with other coupons. Macy's help says its Baby Box ended in February 2026.
notes: Macy's older welcome box product page still shows up in search but help says it ended.

freeStuff: A welcome box with baby and parent items, free with the coupon once you have a registry.
name: Babies "R" Us Welcome Box
whatYouGet: Welcome box of skincare, feeding essentials and accessories, listed at $20 and free with a coupon.
costDetail: Box is free when you apply the coupon from your digital wallet; shipping and tax not stated in the results.
eligibility: Primary registry owner with a free Kohl's Rewards account; one box per customer per year.
valueBasis: Box listed at $20; contents not itemized, so the low end is taken
catches: Time-limited; box cannot be returned. One Kohl's page says the baby registry program may be discontinued, so check before relying on it. Contents not itemized.
notes: Kohl's pages conflict on whether the registry program still runs, so this entry is low confidence.
